t0030-01.gloss: A restaurant order remains unpaid while a routine water check delays the catch.
t0030-01.rival_reading: Officials could have restricted food during an emergency; the note never says what the water check was looking for.

t0030-02.gloss: A delivery record marks goods received before access closed, while the box remains uncollected.
t0030-02.rival_reading: A shipment of field supplies could have been delayed or misrouted; the paperwork does not identify the cargo.
